title: Cancel unfinished descendant before parent
invariant: For one valid Epic with one unfinished Current child, cancellation admits and selects the child for cancellation before the parent.
scope: AST projection covers one valid companion and one unfinished child, with no cycles, concurrent changes, write errors or name collisions. Structural checks inspect the postorder traversal and action construction; Lean does not prove filesystem effects, all tree shapes or full Python equivalence.
